verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a REST API that lets you "access, create and manipulate your content" with Bearer tokens. It backs this with a published OpenAPI 3.0 spec, an interactive try-it reference, and a successor API portal with SDKs. It also offers an official MCP integration and Chat Connectors for Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT, so agents can read and write headlessly without the GUI. The Beta API sunsets on September 1, 2026, but a replacement is already live, and the docs-domain OpenAPI 404 is explained by the spec being hosted at api.capacities.io. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent read/write workflows, explicit documentation of write operations exposed via the MCP/connector path.
